messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: edge-gateway-prod - elevated 5xx rate detected (TLS handshake failures). Current: 18% error rate over baseline. Pager sent to @maria.

maria: oncall here, looking. seeing lots of `tls: handshake timeout` in edge logs. jumping in.

jun: i can join debug. any customer-facing tickets yet?

maria: not yet in Zendesk, but we have spikes starting ~2129998800. traffic peaked to 3xx rps and 5xxs ~350/min.

sarah: running a quick grep on ingress: `grep -i "handshake" /var/log/edge/proxy.log | tail -n 50` — lots of `alert: no ocsp staple` and `tlsv1.3: handshake failure - unknown` in the same window.

tom: interesting — we rolled the new cert chain earlier today from CA X -> intermediate Y -> leaf Z. OCSP stapling for intermediate Y may not be being served. some clients enforce stapling.

maria: can someone `curl -v --tlsv1.3 https://edge.example.internal` from a node in eu-west to reproduce? i want to see OCSP response.

jun: running from eu-west-k8s node:
```
$ curl -v --tlsv1.3 https://edge.example.internal 2>&1 | grep -i ocsp
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Certificate status (22):
* SSL: no OCSP response received
```

jun: corroborates missing OCSP staple.

sarah: checking our cert provisioning logs — the rotator uploaded the new cert chain but the stapling module failed to fetch OCSP from CA due to a 502 from CA's OCSP responder at 2129998745. rotator retried 3x then marked success (bug: success even without staple). filed quick note: `rotator: allow-fail-to-upload-without-staple=false` should have prevented this but config was off.

infra-deploy-bot: deploy #r-2026 pushed certs to edge-proxies at 2129998600 (sha: ab12cd). rollback candidate: previous cert sha ab11bf.

maria: mitigation options —
- A: re-run rotator to fetch OCSP and re-upload, risk short downtime during cert reload.
- B: rollback to previous cert chain (ab11bf) which had valid staple.
- C: route traffic to backup pool in us-east that still has good stapling while we fix.

alice: any customer impact scope? we have one enterprise customer (beta) in EU complaining about connection errors.

maria: initial impact: ~12% of customer traffic returns 525s/526s from edge. mobile clients (older Android) most hit. We'll notify CS if sustained >10min.

tom: quick-check: can we enable OCSP stapling caching in front proxy to serve cached responses while we fix? it reads from `/var/cache/ocsp/` but it's empty for new cert. we'd need a fresh response.

jun: i can re-run rotator with immediate fetch against CA. But CA endpoint is flaky -> use fallback OCSP responder `ocsp-backup.ca.example` used previously.

sarah: i'm comfy with rollback to ab11bf. rollback path tested last week and should be fast (<30s rolling reload). avoids depending on CA flakiness.

maria: agree. rolling back to ab11bf. tom, coordinate proxy reload.

tom: initiating rollback now. command: `edge-rotator rollback --env=prod --sha=ab11bf` — running.

ops-bot: Rolling back certs to ab11bf on 12 proxies. Streaming logs...

ops-bot: proxy-3: reload ok
ops-bot: proxy-7: reload ok
ops-bot: proxy-1: reload ok

sarah: seeing decrease in handshake failures on metrics. 5xx rate dropping to 4% within 45s.

jun: can we confirm OCSP now present on rolled-back cert? running `openssl s_client -status -connect edge.example.internal:443 -servername edge.example.internal` shows `OCSP response: no response sent` for old cert? hmm.

tom: old cert had staple cached on proxies — some clients will succeed right away. but openssl from our node queries CA and may not show cached state.

maria: customer signals: enterprise contact confirmed improved connectivity for their EU region. good.

alice: pinging CS to update the ticket and tell affected customers we've mitigated and investigating root cause. (cc @maria)

infra-deploy-bot: rollback complete on all proxies at 2129999200.

sarah: next steps:
- rota bugfix: make rotator fail if OCSP fetch fails (set flag true) — assigned to sarah
- add health-check against OCSP stapling before marking rotator success — assigned to jun
- add fallback OCSP endpoint to rotator config — assigned to tom
- run postmortem in 24h and remediate processes for cert rollout — owners: eng-runtime + infra

maria: handing off to day oncall @jun for monitoring and postmortem follow-up. i'll update incidents channel and schedule postmortem.

jun: acknowledged handoff. monitoring alert thresholds lowered temporarily to catch any regressions. i'll keep checks for 2 hours.

maria: short summary for incident record (to paste into postmortem): "New cert chain uploaded without valid OCSP staple due to CA ocsp responder 502 + rotator config allowing success without staple. Resulted in TLS handshake failures ~350 5xx/min; mitigated by rolling back to previous cert chain with cached staple. Follow-ups: rotator config fix, OCSP health checks, fallback responder."

maria: closing the pager. will reopen if we see a regression. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — monitoring. severity: SEV2 -> SEV3. tags: tls, cert-rotation, ocsp, rollback
